hero.label: Full-Stack Web Developer
hero.description: Full-stack developer trained at École 42 Paris. I build robust web applications and polished interfaces.

about.title: Designing purposeful digital solutions for high-impact projects
about.p1: After several years in project management and financial monitoring for international NGOs, I chose to pivot into web development to turn my passion for problem-solving into a career.
about.p2: Trained at École 42 Paris, I learned to design and develop applications independently, with a focus on logic, architecture, and code quality.
about.p3: At Japan Awaits, I worked on internal business tools using React, TypeScript, and Laravel, paying close attention to user experience and maintainability.
about.p4: My background gives me a cross-functional perspective: understanding operational needs, structuring efficient solutions, and creating truly useful interfaces for the teams using them daily.
about.location: Based in Toulouse — open to remote and hybrid work

japan-awaits.title: Japan Awaits — Internal Portal
japan-awaits.tagline: Complete overhaul of a custom travel management portal
japan-awaits.description: Full redesign of the internal portal for Japan Awaits agency: booking management, guide tracking, expenses, e-contracts, and dashboards. Built with React + Inertia.js + Laravel, with a focus on separation of concerns.

transcendence.title: ft_transcendence
transcendence.tagline: École 42 final project — complete multiplayer Pong game
transcendence.description: Final curriculum project at École 42, developed in a team of 4. Real-time Pong game featuring authentication, profile management, tournaments, live chat, and Dockerized deployment.

cub3d.title: Cub3D
cub3d.description: Project developed in a pair as part of the 42 curriculum. Implementation of a 3D rendering engine using raycasting in pure C, without high-level graphics libraries. Displays an immersive first-person navigable world with texture management, collisions, and lighting.
highlights: Raycasting algorithm built from scratch in C

timequest.title: TimeQuest
timequest.tagline: Mobile game — guess the dates of historical events
timequest.description: Mobile quiz app where players estimate the dates of major historical events as quickly as possible. Playable solo or multiplayer. Personal project developed as a duo.

biscotte.title: Biscotte
biscotte.description: Mobile app to create, organize, and find personal cooking recipes. Features SQLite local storage, polished UI, ingredient management, preparation steps, and photos. Personal project in progress.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.tagline: This site — designed and developed from scratch
portfolio.description: Personal portfolio built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. High-end design featuring scroll-driven animations, custom cursor, dark/light mode, and bilingual support.
highlights: Consistent Design System with CSS variables

japan.title: Full Stack Web Developer
japan.desc: Migrated a WordPress monolith to a modern Laravel/React (Inertia.js) architecture. Developed end-to-end features, integrated third-party APIs (Bokun, Google), and managed complex business data. Collaborative work using Git with systematic code reviews.

42.title: Digital Technology Architect
42.desc: Common Core validation: Acquired a solid technical foundation through complex C/C++ projects. Developed a Shell (Minishell), 3D graphics projects (Cub3D), and network servers. Expertise in manual memory management (Stack/Heap), concurrent programming (Threads/Mutex), and advanced algorithms. Peer-review and problem-solving based learning without frameworks.

piscine.title: Career Change — Intensive Immersion (Piscine 42)
piscine.desc: Professional transition to development. 4-week selection trial: accelerated learning of C and Shell, problem-solving under pressure, and validation of algorithmic logic.

fiacat.title: Administrative and Financial Officer
fiacat.desc: Administrative and financial management of high-impact international projects and complex budgets (EU, AFD). Budget monitoring, logistical organization, and financial reporting for donors.

contact.description: Currently available for junior opportunities. Feel free to reach out to chat!
